description: Figure 3 is a line chart titled "Ablation Study on HateXplain Dataset," which illustrates the performance variations in precision, recall, and F1-score across five different model variants of MS-FSLHate. The x-axis, labeled "Model Variants," displays five categories: "Full model (Ours)," "w/o Prompt," "w/o Augmentation," "w/o Attention," and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation." The y-axis, labeled "Metric (%)," ranges from 58 to 66, representing the performance metrics in percentage. The chart includes three distinct lines: a purple line with circular markers for Precision, a light blue line with circular markers for Recall, and a tan line with circular markers for F1-score. The full model (Ours) achieves the highest scores for all three metrics, with precision at 65.45%, recall at 65.78%, and F1-score at 65.56%. When the prompt is removed, precision drops to 61.06%, recall to 59.64%, and F1-score to 60.16%. Removing the augmentation module results in a precision of 62.22%, recall of 63.75%, and F1-score of 62.63%. Excluding the attention mechanism leads to a precision of 64.06%, recall of 59.17%, and F1-score of 59.67%. The variant without both prompt and augmentation shows a precision of 65.44%, recall of 56.82%, and F1-score of 57.74%. The legend in the bottom-left corner identifies the lines by their respective metrics.
